field_edits.updated_text: Postoperative tunnel-related changes involving the lateral femoral condyle and proximal tibia. No acute fracture, dislocation, or marrow-replacing lesion.

Complex full-thickness tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus extending to both the superior and inferior articular surfaces, with associated edema/altered signal involving the posterior horn and body.
Heterogeneous altered intrameniscal signal with mild bulky appearance of the anterior horn; posterior horn and body are otherwise maintained.
ACL is postoperative following reconstruction; graft morphology and continuity should be correlated on dedicated sequences.

impression:
1. Complex full-thickness tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus extending to both superior and inferior articular surfaces with associated marrow/soft‑tissue edema.
2. Heterogeneous altered signal and mild bulky appearance of the anterior horn of the lateral meniscus, suspicious for degeneration/intrasubstance injury.
3. Postsurgical tunnel‑related changes of the lateral femoral condyle and proximal tibia related to prior ACL reconstruction; ACL graft appears postoperative, assess integrity on dedicated sequences.
4. No acute osseous abnormality.
